ManagerDeputy.title: Manager deputy
ManagerDeputy.description: A colleague who stands in for a manager for a period: during it, the manager's waiting requests also reach the deputy's approvals inbox, and the deputy is told when one is submitted.
ManagerDeputy.x-notes: self-service-approvals-inbox D2 (REQ-API-002). Nothing is stamped on the requests: the inbox (ApprovalsInboxService) and the submit notifications (ManagerOrDeputyRecipientResolver) resolve the active deputy when they read. ManagerDeputyListener refuses a record whose deputy is the manager, whose last day comes before its first, or that a writer files for another manager without being HR; a record filed without a manager is the writer's own. A deputy approves under the same OpenRegister rights as anyone else: this record scopes the inbox, it grants nothing.
